tag:leader.en: One per warband. Allies within 6″ get +1 on Morale and Suppression tests.

tag:hero.en: Scenario or campaign only; max. 1 per warband.

tag:giant.en: Tier V: scenario only. Source of Fear: a Tier I–II enemy moving within 6″ takes a Nerve test (fail — it cannot approach this activation). Deals triple damage to buildings.

tag:titan.en: A source of Fear like a Giant, but Size 2 — it can enter trenches and buildings.

tag:huge.en: Size 3–4 target: +1 to shoot at it; steps over wooden palisades and models (Size 1).

tag:giant_hunter.en: Giant-Hunter: its weapons wound Size 3–4 targets on a roll −2.

tag:monster_hunter.en: Monster-Hunter: +1 Power against monsters (Monster, Regrowth, devi); automatically passes Fear tests against them.

tag:hunter.en: Hunter: +1 Melee against a target with no friendly model within 3″ of it.

tag:healer.en: Healer: action — an ally within 6″ regains 1 Wound (not above its starting value).

tag:alchemist.en: Alchemy: uses the warband's alchemical gear (Dead Water, Teeth…) as one action, within 3″; in a campaign — the alchemy shop.

tag:engineer.en: Engineer: action — dig 3″ of trench, or restore 1 Wound to a wall section, or cut 3″ of barbed wire.

tag:digger.en: Digs Trenches: action — one 3″ trench section (heavy cover).

tag:cavalry.en: Cavalry: Size 2; crossing a trench costs the whole move (unless it is a Trench-Breaker); in gas without a gas mask the horse panics: −2″ Move.

tag:trench_breaker.en: Trench-Breaker: crosses trenches and barbed wire with no penalty; when it charges, a target in a trench loses heavy cover.

tag:skirmisher.en: Fires on the Move: no shooting penalty after moving.

tag:trick_rider.en: Jiriti Rider: may split its move before and after shooting; −1 to shoot at it after it has moved.

tag:shield_wall.en: Shield Wall: two or more models of this unit within 1″ — each gets +1 Armour.

tag:steam.en: Steam: steam pressure (0–3 tokens, +1 Power each; at the end of the round d10 ≤ tokens → 1 wound); if wounded by Lightning it loses 1 action on its next activation.

tag:vehicle.en: Vehicle: immune to Fear, Morale, Poison and Suppression; crosses trenches only by bridge or as a Trench-Breaker; healed only by Repair.

tag:construct.en: Forged: immune to Fear, Morale, Poison and Suppression; a Healer cannot heal it — only Repair.

tag:fortress.en: Walking Fortress: carries up to 4 Size 1 models; they have heavy cover and shoot from the loopholes. When it falls they climb out, d10 ≤ 3 → 1 wound.

tag:relic.en: Relic: allies within 6″ automatically pass Morale and Fear tests; when it falls, every ally takes a Morale test.

tag:fearless.en: Fearless: never takes Morale, Fear or Suppression tests.

tag:oathbound.en: Oathbound: does not fall back (takes no Morale tests) while its leader lives.

tag:line.en: Line: two or more models of this unit within 1″ — they ignore the long-range penalty.

tag:gas_mask.en: Gas Mask: in a gas cloud it is wounded only on a d10 = 1 (without a gas mask — 1–3).

tag:brawler.en: Trench Brawler: +1 Melee when fighting in a trench, ruin or building.

tag:scout.en: Scout: +1 to Search; after deployment one free move (6″, not within 12″ of an enemy).

tag:infiltrate.en: Ambush: after deployment it sets up anywhere more than 12″ from the enemy and out of its sight.

tag:planted.en: Planted: deploys in secret in the enemy zone or within 6″ of it after both sides have deployed (max. 2 per 500); revealed on its first activation.

tag:silent.en: Silent: until its first attack, enemies more than 6″ away cannot see it.

tag:false_tracks.en: False Tracks: at the start of the battle place 1 false marker; the enemy treats it as a real model until it comes within 6″ (then it is revealed).

tag:night_sight.en: Night-Eye: ignores night and fog penalties; sees ambushing and Silent models within 18″.

tag:clear_sight.en: Trusts No Mirage: within 12″ it sees through ambushes, false markers, murk and illusions — they appear to it as normal.

tag:detect_heretic.en: Knows a Heretic: Planted and Ambushing enemies within 12″ are revealed at once; hired swords within 6″ take no Distrust tests.

tag:climber.en: Cliff-Climber: crosses cliffs, walls and vertical terrain with no penalty.

tag:high_ground.en: From the Heights: +1 to shoot from a cliff, a tower or a rooftop.

tag:mountain.en: Mountain Folk: no movement penalty on mountain, cliff or slope terrain.

tag:river.en: River-Swift: no movement penalty on water, marsh or shore; +3″ moving along a river.

tag:landing.en: Landing: instead of deploying, it may enter in round 1 or 2 from a water or shore edge.

tag:reef.en: Reef: an enemy in the water or on the shore that moves within 3″ of it ends its move.

tag:winter_born.en: Winter-Born: ignores snow, ice and winter penalties.

tag:ice_runner.en: Ice-Swift: +3″ on ice and snow; −2″ in trenches and on cliffs.

tag:ice_reader.en: Reads the Ice: thin ice and models hidden under the ice are revealed within 12″; allies within 6″ move on ice with no penalty.

tag:fell_trees.en: Fells Trees: action — turns a forest feature into 3″ of light cover or a wooden palisade.

tag:rope_bridge.en: Rope Bridge: two actions — a crossing up to 6″ over a trench, chasm or barbed wire (for all allies), or a 3″ rope barrier that stops cavalry.

tag:rail.en: On Rails: on rails +4″ Move and heavy cover; off rails −1 to shoot.

tag:torch.en: Torch: action — lights a fire or bonfire; monsters and night creatures within 3″ take a Nerve test (fail — they cannot approach).

tag:beacon.en: Beacon: action — lights a 9″ radius for one round: ambush, murk and night penalties do not apply there.

tag:wayfinder.en: Wayfinder: at the start of the battle one friendly unit (or itself) may enter from a side edge in round 2.

tag:messenger.en: Messenger: once per round it passes the leader's order or aura to an ally within 12″, as if that ally stood beside the leader.

tag:interpreter.en: Interpreter: allies within 6″ are immune to the Confusion of Tongues (the leader's orders get through).

tag:gong.en: Gong: action — enemies within 6″ take Nerve tests at −1, allies at +1; sea monsters and flyers cannot enter within 6″ while the gong rings (until its next activation).

tag:fire_guard.en: Fireproof: −1 fire damage (min. 0), never catches fire; action — puts out a burning ally within 3″.

tag:burn_gas.en: Burns Gas: action — one gas cloud or murk within 18″ disappears.

tag:third_arrow.en: Third Arrow: the third shot of the battle at the same target gets +2 Power.

tag:marked.en: Marked: once per battle, ignore all damage from one hit.

tag:rage.en: Wrath: once wounded it gets +1 Melee, but must attack the nearest enemy within 6″ and cannot fall back.

tag:madness.en: Madness: after its leader falls it gets +1 Melee, but on every activation it moves toward or attacks the nearest model.

tag:needs_orders.en: Needs Orders: outside 12″ of its leader it has only 1 action per activation.

tag:nameless.en: Nameless: powers aimed at leaders (Leader-Killer, vs. leader) do not affect it.

tag:never_sleeps.en: Never Sleeps: no enemy may deploy in ambush within 12″ of it; Planted and hidden models are revealed at once.

tag:orders.en: Orders: the leader gives an order within 6″ — Volley (+1 Attack) · Close Ranks (+1 Armour) · Advance (+2″).

tag:supply.en: Supply: allies within 6″ reload instantly (no Reload action needed).

tag:repair.en: Repair: action — a vehicle or Forged model within 6″ regains 1 Wound.

tag:song.en: Song: allies within 6″ get +1 Nerve, enemies −1 Melee.

tag:ritual.en: Ritual: allies within 6″ get +1 Power in melee.

tag:witch.en: Witch (Curse): action — a visible enemy within 12″: d10 ≤ its Shoot → −1 Shoot and Melee until the end of the round.

tag:discord.en: Discord: action — an enemy within 12″ takes a Nerve test; on a fail it loses its next activation.

tag:weakness.en: Finds the Weak Spot: action — one enemy within 12″: −1 Armour against all attacks this round.

tag:stitcher.en: Stitcher: in a campaign, raises the fallen as stitched bodies; in battle — by its own power (abilities).

tag:convert.en: Turncoat: once per battle a Tier I–II enemy within 12″ takes a Nerve test; on a fail it is yours for one round.

tag:assassin.en: Assassin: +1 Power with its weapons against leaders and heroes.

tag:fog.en: Murk: once per battle, 3″ of murk within 12″ — no one can see or shoot through it; it lifts with the wind (night table) or at the end of the battle.

tag:regen.en: Regrowth: at the start of its activation +1 Wound, unless wounded this round by fire, lightning or a festering weapon.

tag:undead.en: Stitched Body: immune to Fear, Morale, Poison and Suppression.

tag:split.en: Splits: when it falls, d10 ≤ 4 → 2 small stitched ones appear in its place.

tag:monster.en: Monster: a source of Fear for Tier I (6″); immune to Suppression.

tag:flood.en: Flood: once per battle, action — 3″ radius of mud within 6″: half Move, and trenches fill with water (heavy cover becomes light).

tag:tunnel.en: Tunnel: with two actions the model is removed and next round emerges within 12″ at any ruin, trench or open ground (not within 3″ of an enemy).

tag:devi_pulled.en: Devi-Drawn: when it loses half its Wounds the devis break free, and on every activation their attack hits the nearest model — of either side.

tag:captive.en: Captive: within 6″ of no heretic leader, at the start of each activation d10 ≤ 2 → it breaks free and attacks the nearest model (heretics first).

tag:chain_gang.en: Chain Gang: models of this unit move within 1″ of each other.

tag:cover_for_others.en: Living Wall: an ally standing behind them (within 1″) has light cover.

tag:can_be_freed.en: Can Be Freed: an enemy in contact may cut the chain with one action: d10 ≤ 5 → the model is free and leaves the table.

tag:artillery.en: Artillery: its blasts deal double damage to walls and towers; cannot shoot after moving.

tag:anti_air.en: Sky-Breaker: +1 to shoot at flyers (instead of −1) and +1 Power; a flyer it hits cannot fly on its next activation.

tag:fly.en: Flight: passes over terrain and models; −1 to normal shooting at it.

tag:charge.en: Charge: +1 Power on the first strike after a charge.

tag:blast.en: Blast: on a hit, one other model within 2″ of the target — d10 ≤ 5 → it takes the same wound test.

tag:fire.en: Fire: a wounded model catches fire — at the start of each activation a Power 2 wound test, until it puts the fire out with an action.

tag:lightning.en: Lightning: a wounded steam model loses 1 action on its next activation; stops Regrowth.

tag:poison.en: Poison: a wounded model (not Forged/vehicle/stitched) loses 1 more Wound on a d10 ≤ 5.

tag:armor_break.en: Armour-Breaker: −1 to the target's Armour on the wound test.

tag:anti_giant.en: Anti-Giant: wounds Size 3–4 targets on a roll −2.

tag:vs_leader.en: Leader-Killer: +1 Power against leaders and heroes.

tag:sweep.en: Sweep: in melee each attack also hits a second nearby enemy on a d10 ≤ 5.

tag:indirect.en: Indirect: ignores the cover penalty and needs no line of sight if an ally can see the target.

tag:reload.en: Reload: after firing, one Reload action before it can fire again.

tag:demolition.en: Demolition: double damage to trenches, barbed wire, walls, towers and fortifications.

tag:volley.en: Volley: two or more models of this unit shoot the same target — each gets +1 Attack.

tag:suppress.en: Suppress: a Size 1 model shot at (hit or not) gets a token — −1 to shoot at it; on activation a Nerve test, fail: 1 action, cannot move or attack.

tag:pin.en: Pins: a model hit (no wound needed) cannot move on its next activation; cavalry loses its charge bonus.

tag:entangle.en: Entangle: a model hit cannot move on its next activation.

tag:grab.en: Grab: a model hit cannot move on its next activation.

tag:chain.en: Chain: a Size 3+ model hit makes only half a move on its next activation.

tag:chain_breaker.en: Chain-Breaker: immune to Chain, Entangle and Pins; double damage to Chain Wagons and harnessed monsters.

tag:festering.en: Festering: a wounded model cannot regrow this round, and its wound cannot be healed.

tag:capture.en: Capture: a model felled by this weapon is taken captive.

tag:curse.en: Curse: see Witch — no wound needed.

tag:unleash.en: Unleash: once per battle its Power is doubled; afterwards the bearer is uncontrolled (attacks the nearest model).

tag:swallow.en: Swallow: a Size 1 model hit, d10 ≤ 3 → swallowed; it returns with 1 Wound when the swallower falls.

tag:aura.en: Aura: a power that is always active (described in the unit's abilities).

common:დათესილი მეომარი.en:
Sown Warrior
Mv 5 · Me 5 · Ar 1 · Wd 1 · Nv 10 · sword (1 Attack, Power 2). Activates as your model; crumbles at the end of the battle and does not count toward the warband. On its own activation d10 = 1 → it attacks the nearest model (of either side) — in the myth, the sown warriors turned on each other.

common:პატარა ნაკერი.en:
Small Stitched One
Mv 4 · Me 5 · Ar 1 · Wd 1 · Nv 10 · fist (1 Attack, Power 2); immune to Fear and Poison.

common:წაქცეული.en:
Knocked Down
On its next activation the model has only 1 action.

common:უკან ყრა.en:
Hurled Back
The model is moved the stated distance directly away from the attacker; it stops if it hits a wall or a model. A model hurled out of a trench loses its cover.

abil:lashkari#0.en:
Sons of the Trench
Lashkari in a trench or heavy cover get +1 on Morale and Fear tests.

abil:dali_hunters#0.en:
Patient
+1 to shoot if it has not moved this activation.

abil:dali_hunters#1.en:
Great Game
= Giant-Hunter: wounds Size 3–4 targets on a roll −2.

abil:eristavi#0.en:
Follow Me!
Once per round, at the end of the Eristavi's activation, one not-yet-activated Colchian within 3″ activates immediately.

abil:eristavi#1.en:
Blood of the Aeetids
While the Eristavi lives, Colchians within 6″ automatically pass Morale tests.

abil:eristavi#2.en:
Weakness
When the Eristavi falls, every Colchian immediately takes a Morale test — regardless of losses.

abil:aznauri#0.en:
A Knight's Challenge
Once per battle, after a charge: an enemy of Tier II+ in contact is in a duel. While both live and remain in contact, no one else may join their melee, and both get +1 Melee.

abil:kolkhi_riders#0.en:
Charge into the Trench
When it charges, a target in a trench is hurled back 1″ (out of the trench) and loses heavy cover for this fight.

abil:gurian_riders#0.en:
Jiriti
The move action may be split before and after shooting (half + half); no shooting penalty after moving.

abil:gurian_riders#1.en:
Horse-Shield
After it moves, until its next activation, −1 to shoot at it.

abil:medea_sisters#0.en:
Dead Water
= Healer: action — an ally within 6″ regains 1 Wound.

abil:medea_sisters#1.en:
Sowing the Dragon's Teeth
Once per battle, action: place 2 Sown Warriors within 3″.

abil:shavkhan_smiths#0.en:
Repair Crew
Action: a vehicle or steam model within 3″ regains 1 Wound.

abil:shavkhan_smiths#1.en:
Demolition
Its explosives deal double damage to trenches, barbed wire, walls and towers.

abil:monaspa#0.en:
Living Shield
Behind two or more Monaspa (within 1″ of each other), an ally standing within 1″ has light cover.

abil:iron_arm_veterans#0.en:
Feels No Pain
Once per battle the first wound it takes is ignored on a d10 ≤ 3.

abil:khalkotavri#0.en:
Horn Charge
When it charges, Size 1 models in contact are hurled back 2″.

abil:khalkotavri#1.en:
Weakness: the Back
Shooting and attacks from behind (the Khalkotauros' rear half) are against −1 Armour.

abil:ambri_ox#0.en:
Ambri's Furrow
After each move action, 3″ of trench is left along its path (max. 1 per activation).

abil:ambri_ox#1.en:
Relic
Colchians within 6″ automatically pass Morale and Fear tests.

abil:ambri_ox#2.en:
Weakness
When the Ox of Ambri falls, every Colchian immediately takes a Morale test.

abil:golden_ram#0.en:
Bronze Horns
Its charge wrecks 3″ of trench, barbed wire or a wall section in its path; Size 1 models are hurled back 2″.

abil:golden_ram#1.en:
Unstoppable
Once per round it ignores one stopping effect (Chain, Entangle, Pins, Lightning).

abil:golden_ram#2.en:
Weakness: the Belly-Boiler
Giant-Hunter weapons deal +1 damage to it.

abil:fleece_dragon#0.en:
Never Sleeps
No enemy may deploy in ambush within 12″ of it; Planted and hidden models are revealed at once.

abil:fleece_dragon#1.en:
Bronze Wings
Flight: passes over terrain and models; weakness — the second wing: only every other round (1, 3, 5…).

abil:fleece_dragon#2.en:
The Golden Scrap
A campaign scenario rule; has no effect in an ordinary battle.

abil:hero_zurab#0.en:
Father of Soldiers
Lashkari within 6″ of him get +1 Melee.

abil:hero_zurab#1.en:
An Old Score
+1 Attack in melee against Marquis Sabnock.

abil:hero_eliso#0.en:
Medea's Cauldron
Once per battle, action: a fallen ally within 3″ returns with 1 Wound.

abil:hero_eliso#1.en:
Devi Teeth
Once per battle, action: place 3 Sown Warriors (+1 Melee) within 3″; they "turn on each other" on a d10 of 1–2.

abil:hero_eliso#2.en:
Thrice Risen
The first two times she falls, d10 ≤ 5 → she rises with 1 Wound.

abil:khevsur#0.en:
Swordplay
In melee, the first attack against it each round is at −1 to hit.

abil:khevsur#1.en:
Chain Shirt
+1 Armour against the secondary hit of a blast (a blast aimed at another target).

abil:tush_shepherds#0.en:
Scent
No enemy may deploy in ambush within 12″; Planted and hidden enemies within 12″ are revealed at once.

abil:tush_shepherds#1.en:
The Heretic's Smell
Your hired models within 6″ take no Distrust tests.

abil:mountain_sappers#0.en:
Rockfall
Once per battle, action: a cliff or ruin within 12″ collapses — a 3″ radius becomes impassable for the rest of the battle; models inside, d10 ≤ 5 → 1 wound.

abil:spasalari#0.en:
Mountain Command
Once per round, at the end of its activation: two not-yet-activated Iberians within 6″ activate immediately — with 1 action each.

abil:spasalari#1.en:
Engines before Glory
Thunderbolt Gunners within 6″ get +1 Shoot.

abil:natsiliani#0.en:
The Mark
Once per battle, ignore all damage from one hit.

abil:lightning_gunners#0.en:
Burning the Cloud
Action: one gas cloud or murk within 18″ disappears.

abil:lightning_gunners#1.en:
Weakness: the Battery
When an attack on it rolls a natural 1, the battery explodes: every model within 2″, d10 ≤ 3 → 1 wound.

abil:tush_riders#0.en:
Shooting from the Saddle
No shooting penalty after moving.

abil:ekimbashi#0.en:
Dead Water
= Healer: action — an ally within 6″ regains 1 Wound.

abil:ekimbashi#1.en:
Raised by Lightning
Once per battle, action: an ally within 3″ who fell this round or last rises with 1 Wound; at the end of the next round it falls for good.

abil:fortress_guards#0.en:
Piston Shield
A Size 1 enemy it hits in melee is hurled back 2″.

abil:fortress_guards#1.en:
Living Shield
Behind two or more Wardens (within 1″), an ally standing within 1″ has light cover.

abil:iakhsar_shields#0.en:
Devi-Slayer
The war hammer gets +1 Power against monsters (Monster, Regrowth).

abil:iakhsar_shields#1.en:
Earthquake
Once per battle, action: Size 1 enemies within 2″, d10 ≤ 5 → Knocked Down.

abil:steam_ibex#0.en:
Cliff-Walker
Crosses cliffs, walls and vertical terrain with no penalty.

abil:lightning_castle#0.en:
Lightning Coil
At the end of each round every model within 6″ (of either side), d10 ≤ 2 → a Power 3 lightning wound test.

abil:lightning_castle#1.en:
Garrison
Up to 4 of your Size 1 models fit inside; they shoot from the loopholes with heavy cover. When the keep falls they climb out, d10 ≤ 3 → 1 wound.

abil:armazi_colossus#0.en:
Gaze of Armazi
Iberians within 12″ automatically pass Fear and Morale tests; enemies within 12″ get −1 Nerve.

abil:armazi_colossus#1.en:
Sea Wave
A one-shot weapon; also puts out every fire and gas within 3″ of the wave.

abil:armazi_colossus#2.en:
Gaim's Alchemy
Once per battle the colossus regains 2 Wounds.

abil:armazi_colossus#3.en:
Weakness: the Eyes
When it has lost half its Wounds, −2″ Move.

abil:hero_amirani#0.en:
Chain-Breaker
Immune to Chain, Entangle and Pins; deals double damage in melee to Chain Wagons and harnessed monsters. Breaking a chain is an action in contact.

abil:hero_amirani#1.en:
Qursha
Once per battle, the hound Qursha takes one hit aimed at Amirani — the damage is ignored.

abil:hero_amirani#2.en:
Warden of Ambri
+1 Melee and +1 Nerve in Ambri's Furrow scenarios.

abil:recruits#0.en:
All Alike
A single order from the leader within 6″ applies to all Vat Recruits at once.

abil:recruits#1.en:
Needs Orders
Outside 12″ of the leader it has only 1 action per activation.

abil:legion_shooters#0.en:
Discipline
Two or more Riflemen within 1″ of each other — +1 on Morale tests.

abil:marquis#0.en:
The Plan
Before the battle, secretly write down one objective or enemy model. If at the end of the battle the objective is yours or the model has fallen — +1 victory point (+1 rank in a campaign).

abil:halphas_fortifiers#0.en:
Fortress by Night
Once per battle, with 2 actions: a 3″ sandbag wall (heavy cover; Armour 4, 6 Wounds).

abil:malphas_wreckers#0.en:
Demolition
The mine and the lance deal double damage to trenches, barbed wire, walls and towers.

abil:malphas_wreckers#1.en:
Weakness: the Charge
If it falls before using the lance, d10 ≤ 3 → a 2″ Power 3 blast (hits both sides).

abil:andras_whisperers#0.en:
A Familiar Voice
Once per round: if an enemy fails the Whisperers' Discord test, instead of losing its activation you may have it shoot its nearest ally once.

abil:glasya_killers#0.en:
Leader-Killer
+1 Power with its weapons against leaders and heroes.

abil:glasya_killers#1.en:
Unseen Approach
Until their first activation they cannot be shot from more than 12″ away.

abil:legionnaires#0.en:
In Step
Two or more Legionnaires within 1″ of each other automatically pass Morale tests.

abil:furcas_riders#0.en:
Knight's Charge
Their charge cuts barbed wire (3″ is removed).

abil:marchosias_wolves#0.en:
The Hunt
+1 Melee against a target with no friendly model within 3″ of it.

abil:behemoth_spawn#0.en:
Trample
Size 1 models in the path of its charge, d10 ≤ 3 → 1 wound.

abil:behemoth_spawn#1.en:
Wrath
After being wounded by fire or lightning, on its next activation it attacks the nearest model — of either side.

abil:mulciber_forge#0.en:
Field Repair
Action: a Legionnaire or vehicle within 6″ regains 1 Wound.

abil:standard_fortress#0.en:
Legion Standard
Order range extends to 12″ of it; no confusion after the leader falls.

abil:standard_fortress#1.en:
Stronghold
Legionnaires within 2″ of it have heavy cover.

abil:standard_fortress#2.en:
Weakness
When it falls, every Legionnaire immediately takes a Morale test.

abil:behemoth#0.en:
Earthquake
At the end of its activation, Size 1 models within 3″, d10 ≤ 3 → Knocked Down; any trench section it crosses collapses.

abil:behemoth#1.en:
Endless Hunger
Each model it fells — +1 Wound (not above its starting value).

abil:behemoth#2.en:
Weakness
After its leader falls, on every activation it attacks the nearest model — of either side.

abil:hero_sabnock#0.en:
Fortress by Night
At the start of the battle place a 3″ stone wall anywhere in the middle strip.

abil:hero_sabnock#1.en:
Festering Wound
Wounds he inflicts cannot be closed by a Healer — only by an alchemist.

abil:hero_sabnock#2.en:
An Old Score
+1 Attack in melee against Zurab Bronze-Arm.

abil:rebels#0.en:
Brother against Brother
Once per battle: the first light-side model to attack this unit in melee gets −1 Melee on that attack (a familiar face).

abil:rebel_chief#0.en:
The Word
While the chief lives, Rebels within 6″ get +1 Melee.

abil:rebel_chief#1.en:
Nameless
Powers aimed at leaders (Leader-Killer and the like) do not affect him.

abil:blood_priests#0.en:
Taking Captives
= Capture: a model felled by the ritual knife is taken captive (a point in a scenario; the altar in a campaign).

abil:kudiani#0.en:
Gathering Hearts
Every enemy that falls within 6″ of her — +1 Wound (max. starting value +1).

abil:kudiani#1.en:
Weakness
After being wounded by fire or lightning, all her curses end.

abil:chain_shooters#0.en:
Two Chains
If two chains hit a Size 3+ target in one round, it cannot move on its next activation.

abil:kaji_smith#0.en:
Stitching
Once per battle, action: in place of a fallen Size 1 model (of either side) within 3″, place a Kaji-Stitched with 2 Wounds.

abil:kaji_smith#1.en:
Devi Blood
Action: a heretic within 3″ gets +1 Melee and +1 Power until the end of the battle; d10 = 1 → maddened: on every activation it attacks the nearest model.

abil:chained_ones#0.en:
Slipping the Chains
Once per battle: the heavy chains have double Power this activation; afterwards, until the end of the battle, they attack the nearest model on every activation — of either side.

abil:kaji_stitched#0.en:
Feels No Pain
= Stitched Body: immune to Fear, Morale and Poison.

abil:kaji_stitched#1.en:
Falling to Pieces
When it falls, d10 ≤ 4 → 2 small stitched ones in its place.

abil:kaji_stitched#2.en:
Weakness
Fire deals +1 damage to it.

abil:devi_spawn#0.en:
Many Heads
Its 3 attacks may be split among different models within 1″.

abil:gveleshapi#0.en:
Flood
Once per battle, action: mud in a 6″ radius — half Move, and trenches fill with water (heavy cover becomes light).

abil:gveleshapi#1.en:
Swallow Whole
A Size 1 model hit, d10 ≤ 3 → swallowed (remove it); it returns with 1 Wound when the Gveleshapi falls.

abil:chain_wagon#0.en:
Rolling Altar
Sacrificing a captive within 3″ of it — heretics within 6″ get +1 Power this round.

abil:chain_wagon#1.en:
Weakness: the Chains
When it has lost half its Wounds the devis break free: on every activation the harnessed devis attack the nearest model — of either side.

abil:bakbak_devi#0.en:
The Mightiest
+1 damage against vehicles and fortifications.

abil:bakbak_devi#1.en:
Captive
At the start of each activation, if no heretic leader stands within 6″, d10 ≤ 2 → it breaks free and attacks the nearest model until the end of the battle — heretics first.

abil:hero_nameless#0.en:
Many Tongues
Once per battle, action: a Tier I–II enemy within 12″ takes a Nerve test; on a fail it is your model for one round.

abil:hero_nameless#1.en:
Many Faces
Ambushing and scout models are at −1 Shoot against him.

abil:hero_nameless#2.en:
Past a Hundred Years
Once per battle, when he falls, d10 ≤ 3 → he rises with 1 Wound.

abil:voice_mimics#0.en:
False Order
Once per round, one enemy unit within 12″ takes a Nerve test; on a fail it cannot activate this round.

abil:flask_smiths#0.en:
Stitched Bodies
In a campaign: after the battle one fallen model returns as a stitched body on a d10 of 6+.

abil:lock_smiths#0.en:
The Weak Spot
One enemy within 6″ — your attacks against it this round get +1 to wound.

abil:field_sisters#0.en:
Field Hospital
= Healer, but within 3″: action — an ally regains 1 Wound.

abil:hero_kalistrate#0.en:
The Planted Leader
The only leader who appears in the enemy zone under the Planted rule.

abil:hero_levan#0.en:
Four-Tongues
His orders reach allies without an interpreter (the Confusion of Tongues does not apply).

abil:vahagn_slayers#0.en:
Scent of the Vishap
Within 6″ of a Tier IV–V or Monster target they automatically pass Nerve and Fear tests.

abil:vahagn_slayers#1.en:
Weakness: Sparks
The fire lance cannot fire if a steam ally is within 2″.

abil:aralez_keepers#1.en:
The Return
Once per battle: an ally that fell within 3″ this round rises with 1 Wound on a d10 ≤ 3.

abil:aralez_keepers#2.en:
Weakness: the Aralez
The first wound taken hits the aralez (the hound) — both powers are lost.

abil:basat_hunters#0.en:
A Shot to the Eye
A natural 1 (critical) on a Size 3–4 target — it gets −2 Shoot until the end of the battle.

abil:cyclops_hunters#0.en:
The Eye
A natural 1 (critical) on a Size 3–4 target — it gets −2 Shoot until the end of the battle.

abil:koroglu_riders#0.en:
Qirat's Leap
Once per battle they leap barbed wire or a wall section with no penalty.

abil:set_spearmen#0.en:
The Prow
Once per battle, when a monster or Tier IV–V model charges them, they fire the spear cannon before it arrives (if loaded).

abil:sekhmet_warriors#0.en:
Wrath
= Wrath (tag): once wounded +1 Melee; they attack the nearest enemy within 6″.

abil:yu_canal_diggers#0.en:
Draining the Water
Once per battle, action: one flooded trench within 6″ dries out, or one gas cloud disappears.

abil:tripod_scholars#0.en:
Atlas of Monsters
Action: a monster or Tier IV–V model within 12″ — allies strike it with +1 Power this round.

abil:xiangliu_hunters#0.en:
Nine Heads
The volley gun gets +1 Attack against a many-headed monster (Regrowth).

abil:three_companions#0.en:
The Dog
Sees ambushing and Silent models within 12″.

abil:three_companions#2.en:
The Pheasant
At the start of the battle one ambushing or Planted enemy is revealed.

abil:karakuri_soldiers#0.en:
The Mainspring
In rounds 3 and 6 they have only 1 action per activation (the spring is being wound).

abil:vikram_blades#0.en:
Oath of Patience
Fearless; immune to Discord, Curses and False Orders.

abil:net_weavers#0.en:
Steel Net
A model hit cannot move on its next activation; Size 3–4 — −3″ Move. One action (folding the net) before it can throw again.

abil:mirror_marksmen#0.en:
Periscope
After shooting from heavy cover, until their next activation, an extra −1 to shoot at them.

abil:storytellers#0.en:
The Tale
Action: an ally within 6″ that has fallen back returns (retakes the Nerve test), or one model rerolls a failed test.

abil:hammer_crew#0.en:
John Henry's Song
Once per battle: they strike twice with the steam hammer this activation, then take 1 wound.

abil:lumberjacks#0.en:
The Hidebehind
Enemies attacking them in the forest from ambush or from behind do not get +1 Melee.

abil:fire_runners#0.en:
The Torch
= Torch; also works against winged creatures.

abil:sky_watchers#0.en:
Watcher of the Sky
Night-Eye at 24″; once per battle an enemy flyer is revealed before its first activation, and the first shot at it is without the −1.

abil:papa_bois_scouts#0.en:
Forest Paths
On a forest map they deploy 6″ further forward.

abil:chaski_runners#0.en:
The Message
= Messenger: if they start within 6″ of the leader and end their move beside an ally, that ally counts as beside the leader this round.

abil:khettara_diggers#0.en:
Water
Once per battle allies within 6″ regain 1 Wound.

abil:agadir_guards#0.en:
Guarding the Granary
Within 3″ of an objective they automatically pass Fear and Morale tests.

abil:gate_wardens#0.en:
Guarding the Gate
Within 3″ of an objective they automatically pass Fear and Morale tests.

abil:belenos_shields#0.en:
Guarding the Bridge
On a bridge, a ford or within 3″ of an objective they automatically pass Fear and Morale tests.

abil:tlaloc_shields#0.en:
Ring of Fire
Within 3″ of a torch, bonfire or objective they automatically pass Fear and Morale tests.

abil:rostam_heirs#0.en:
The Tiger-Skin
They automatically pass Fear tests against giants and monsters.

abil:pearl_divers#0.en:
The Dive
No penalty in water; once per battle one round underwater — they cannot be shot.

abil:olonkho_singers#0.en:
Song of the Epic
= Song; creatures of the underworld and demons within 6″ get −1 Melee. A singer cannot move while singing (on its own activation).

abil:dokkaebi_bargainers#0.en:
Cunning
Once per round, action: an enemy model within 12″ has only 1 action on its next activation (no test).

abil:haetae_firewardens#0.en:
The Hose
= Fireproof; action — every burning ally within 3″ is put out.

abil:dragon_born#0.en:
Dragon Wings
+1 Melee against flyers and weather creatures.

abil:dragon_born#1.en:
Weakness: the Wings
After being wounded by fire or lightning they cannot fly for one round.

abil:wind_readers#0.en:
Foretelling the Weather
Before the battle: their side may choose the result of the night table for one round.

abil:basajaun_shepherds#0.en:
Sign of the Forest Lord
At the start of the battle one ambushing or Planted enemy unit is revealed.

abil:ice_climbers#0.en:
Charge from the Cliff
+1 Melee when charging from a cliff, wall or slope.

abil:avalanche_sappers#0.en:
Avalanche
On a mountain map the avalanche charge also creates a 3″ avalanche strip: crossing it eats the whole move (for the rest of the battle).

abil:amber_alchemists#1.en:
Resin Seal
Once per battle one objective or wall section is undamageable for one round.

abil:drovers#0.en:
The Herd's Trail
Once per battle, while moving: the strip they cross (2″ wide) is impassable to fire for the rest of the battle.

abil:harz_miners#0.en:
The Kobold's Knock
Enemies emerging from a tunnel or from ambush within 6″ of them are revealed at once and get no +1 Melee on their first attack.

abil:dike_wardens#0.en:
The Sluice
= Flood (3″ radius), only in low ground or beside a trench.

abil:salt_miners#0.en:
The Skarbnik's Knock
Once per battle they automatically pass a rockfall, trap or blast test.

abil:fire_siphoneers#0.en:
Sea Fire
Fire burns even on water: a fire marker left on water damages anyone entering it for 2 rounds.

abil:tulumbaci#0.en:
Firefighting
= Fireproof; they put out a fire marker without an action if they end their activation within 1″ of it.

abil:shadow_players#0.en:
Shadow Theatre
Once per battle: an enemy shot at them automatically hits a false shadow (a miss) — revealed after the shot.

abil:praetorians#0.en:
The Guard
Within 3″ of the leader: a hit aimed at the leader (before the wound test) may be taken by this model instead.

abil:hoplites#0.en:
Spear Rank
The spear strikes at 2″ — even from the second rank.

abil:mehter_drummers#0.en:
Voice of the Drum
= Song; in addition, allies within 6″ are immune to voices, False Orders and Discord.

abil:klabauter_crews#0.en:
The Klabautermann
Once per battle: a vehicle or boat within 6″ avoids critical damage (one hit).

abil:polianitsa#0.en:
Bogatyr
Rare (1 per warband); Winter-Born; when she charges she hurls a Size 1 target back 2″.

abil:byzantium_grotesque#0.en:
The Lion's Roar
= Discord; the roar may target two models (within 12″) in one activation.

role:command.en: Leader: morale, orders, the chain of activations. 1 is required per warband.

role:line.en: Cheap, numerous trench troops: holding objectives, rifle fire in line.

role:assault.en: Clearing trenches at close range: frenzy, trench brawling, night raids.

role:sniper.en: Long, accurate shooting; hunting leaders and specialists.

role:scout.en: Ambush, sight, searching No Man's Land, finding snipers.

role:heavy_weapons.en: Machine-guns and volley fire — **suppression**: pins infantry down and stops them.

role:artillery.en: Blasts and indirect fire; wrecking fortifications and groups.

role:support.en: Healing, alchemy, song, ritual, supply — makes others stronger.

role:disruptor.en: Curses, discord, infiltration, assassination — breaking the enemy's order.

role:heavy_infantry.en: Armour and the shield wall; holding the line and charging.

role:cavalry.en: Speed, charges, breaking trenches, the flank.

role:flyer.en: Passes over terrain; normal shooting at it is at −1.

role:armor.en: Steam engines and walking fortresses: firepower and endurance.

role:monster.en: Living evil: regrowth, fear, melee power.

role:giant.en: Tier V — scenario only; wrecks everything.
